Interface CashLedgerRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<CashLedgerEntry>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>
public interface CashLedgerRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<CashLedgerEntry, UUID>
Repository for cash ledger entries. Provides methods to query and aggregate cash ledger data by account and currency.

  • Method Details

    • sumAmountsByAccountIds

      @Query("SELECT c.accountId AS accountId, c.currency AS currency, SUM(c.amount) AS total FROM CashLedgerEntry c WHERE c.accountId IN :accountIds GROUP BY c.accountId, c.currency") List<CashLedgerRepository.AccountTotal> sumAmountsByAccountIds(@Param("accountIds") List<UUID> accountIds)
      Sums the cash amounts for the specified account IDs, grouped by account and currency.
      Parameters:
      accountIds - the list of account IDs to sum amounts for
      Returns:
      a list of AccountTotal objects representing the summed amounts by account and currency

    • sumAmountByAccountIdAndCurrency

      @Query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.amount), 0) FROM CashLedgerEntry c WHERE c.accountId = :accountId AND c.currency = :currency") BigDecimal sumAmountByAccountIdAndCurrency(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId, @Param("currency") String currency)
      Sums the cash amounts for the specified account ID and currency.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID to sum amounts for
      currency - the currency to sum amounts for
      Returns:
      the total cash amount for the specified account and currency

    • findByAccountIdInAndCreatedAtAfter

      List<CashLedgerEntry> findByAccountIdInAndCreatedAtAfter(Collection<UUID> accountIds, OffsetDateTime after)
      Finds every entry on the given accounts recorded after a point in time, used to walk the current cash balance back to what it was at that time.
      Parameters:
      accountIds - the account IDs to include
      after - the exclusive lower bound on the entry's creation time
      Returns:
      the matching entries, in no particular order

    • findFirstByExecutionId

      Optional<CashLedgerEntry> findFirstByExecutionId(UUID executionId)
      Finds the most recent cash ledger entry for a given execution ID.
      Parameters:
      executionId - the execution ID to search for
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the most recent cash ledger entry for the given execution ID, or empty if no entry is found
